findings.description: `_prepare_draw` and `bind_map` in `player_map_viewport.gd` assign `_map.drawn_frame = _frame` on the `MapData` object, which holds the simulation's visibility arrays, and also set `_camera.drawn_frame`. findings.description: The new branch in `_process` keeps the hover card only while `_payload.day == drawn_frame.day`, and builds a new payload only when `displayed_fields_current()` is true, which requires `drawn_frame.day == received_day`. When batches arrive on most frames (for example at 50×), the drawn day moves past the payload's day while `received_day` has already moved ahead again, so the card is dismissed on almost every map draw and seldom gets a frame where it can rebuild.

findings.description: `_publish_worker_map()` returns on a failed texture encode without updating `drawn_frame.staged_day`, even though `received_day` has advanced and the pending map update is cleared, so `displayed_fields_current()` remains false. If no later publication succeeds, as when the game is paused, new cell selections and other map-dependent inspector views keep waiting for a current draw while the map-view notification can still advance.

evidence.explanation: The rule requires background-day tests to wait for the committed day with `wait_for_runtime_day` and run the production receive step. This loop waits only until the observed received day grows, and then asserts receipts that depend on the receive step.

findings.description: `PlayerMapViewport` copies the window's `canvas_transform` into the SubViewport only in `frame_pre_draw`. Layers now inside it (MapActivityLayer, TradeActivityLayer, settlement labels, sky background) read `get_viewport().get_canvas_transform()` during `_process`, so their culling and screen-space math always uses the previous frame's camera. While panning or zooming, icons and labels at the screen edge can be missing or misplaced for a frame, while the map texture itself is drawn with the current transform.
findings.title: Map layers cull with the previous frame's camera

evidence.explanation: The transform is assigned only in the pre-draw callback. The listed layers sample it during `_process`, which runs before pre-draw in each frame.

findings.description: `reset_worker_views()` clears `_held_ui_refreshes`, but `GameUIManager._country_refresh_queued` stays true for a flush that was held there. Every later `_mark_country_panel_dirty` returns early on that flag. If UI refresh was held during a load or session cancel, the country panel never refreshes again until it is closed and reopened.
findings.title: Country panel can stop refreshing after a reload

evidence.explanation: When `defer_ui_refresh` holds the callback, `_flush_country_panel_refresh` returns while `_country_refresh_queued` is still true. Reset then drops the held callback without notifying the owner.
